meta.description: Reviewed market-regime commentary. These reports are separate from mechanical headline climate; each report states evidence and unverified assumptions.
meta.source: ChatGPT interactive or scheduled deep research
meta.writeProtocol: append newest review to reviews; preserve older reviews; do not overwrite existing IDs

reviews.headline: India's domestic rotation is promising, but global risk remains two-sided

regime.confidenceReason: Reviewed news links and initial editorial baseline, not a complete market pricing and consensus revision model.
verifiedFactors: Dated articles describe renewed foreign attention to Indian equities and banking/auto performance.
Persistent oil-shipping and geopolitical headlines remain a macro uncertainty.
Central-bank inflation and AI-capex themes have competing directions.
missingFactors: No validated daily Indian sector relative-strength breadth series.
No live sovereign/issuer CDS pricing or credit-spread timeseries.
No systematic analyst earnings revision changes or company valuation mapping.
No robust two-window news-history comparison yet.

sectors.why: India inflows and liquid financials received attention; earnings quality and credit costs must confirm.
sectors.trigger: FPI inflows repeat and bank earnings revisions improve with stable credit stress
sectors.risk: Inflows reverse or funding costs remain elevated

sectors.why: Domestic market leadership may extend into suppliers, but dealer inventory and raw-material margins matter.
sectors.trigger: Retail registrations, OEM dispatches and margins confirm demand
sectors.risk: Higher funding costs and inputs erode affordability

sectors.why: Lower crude may relieve cost pressure; shipping disruptions and freight can offset savings.
sectors.trigger: Lower oil AND lower landed inputs/freight show up in gross margins
sectors.risk: Hormuz incidents, insurance costs and volatility

sectors.why: Valuation anxiety coexists with strong ongoing AI demand; do not declare a reversal without capex and earnings evidence.
sectors.proxy: Data-centre power; grid equipment; software providers
sectors.trigger: Order books and hyperscaler capex diverge materially from market expectations
sectors.risk: Sector rebounds; hardware and software diverge

sectors.stance: Structural, not a fresh cyclical signal
sectors.why: Industry bed expansion is an established investment story; only verified cash returns justify valuation.
sectors.trigger: Higher incremental hospital EBITDA and ROIC

topRisks.watch: Physical disruption + freight or crude confirmation

topRisks.transmission: Discount rates, household purchasing power, funding costs
Export orders, duty costs, tariff exposure
topRisks.watch: Enacted rules and company revenue impact
Issuer CDS requires specialist data; use verified rating events and public spread proxies

reviews.sincePrevious: Initial AI review; no earlier equivalent AI review exists.
whatToVerifyNext: Daily FPI flow persistence and NSE sector breadth
Realized Brent, freight and Indian input-margin transmission
Bank asset quality and analyst revision changes

reviews.limitations: Provisional interpretive baseline from a limited news and sector context sample. Cannot infer actual current financial conditions, full market sentiment, CDS levels or forward returns. No buy/sell recommendation.
